slides.notes: These are your speaker notes. Only you see them, in speaker view; the audience sees just the slides. Replace them with what you want to say. Set expectations: how long this takes and when you'll take questions.
Walk through the agenda in a few seconds; don't present it item by item.
Lead with the headline: did we hit our targets? Then go number by number.
Explain what moved each number, not just the number itself.
Pick one item to demo or show if there's time.
Keep the before side short; spend your time on what changed.
Be clear about what's committed and what's still a guess.
If people remember only one thing, which one should it be? Say it again here.
Repeat each question before you answer it, so everyone hears it.
